slug: 2025-04-01 South Africa Department of Home Affairs Strategic Plan 2025-2030

facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs' own Strategic Plan 2025 to 2030, tabled in April 2025, carries online birth registration at high-volume health facilities as the department's work.

The Department of Home Affairs' Strategic Plan 2025 to 2030, tabled in April 2025, provides for online birth registration at high-volume health facilities, from a baseline of 8 of 91 priority facilities equipped, with connectivity and IT capacity named as the blocker.
